items.summary: Update the backend actor initialization flow to never leave authenticated users stuck on an indefinite “Initializing…” UI; if actor creation or `initializeAccessControl()` fails, the UI must transition to a visible error state with clear next actions.

Enhance `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts` to expose explicit actor readiness and error status (e.g., `isLoading`, `isReady`, `isError`, `error`) and provide a real `refetch`/retry mechanism that consumers can call.

Update `frontend/src/hooks/useActorReady.ts` and `frontend/src/components/ActorInitializationGate.tsx` to use the new readiness/error status and display an error Alert UI (with a Retry button) when initialization fails.
